Re: Add support for selecting and operating on columns in DataFrames

The first cut of the Column API was merged in https://github.com/amplab-extras/SparkR-pkg/pull/188

Some other APIs which would be good to support include

Column selection:

  # Selecting the first column
  df[[1]]
  df[["V1"]]
  df[,1]

  # Selecting the first two columns
  df[,1:2]
  df[,c("V1", "V2")]

   # Column assignment, mutating the DF
   df$V3 <- df$V1 + df$V2

I think we can implement this by overriding the `[`, `[[` and assignment operators in the DataFrame S4 class (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/24253048/whats-the-difference-between-setmethod-and-set-setreplacemethod might be useful)
